common: Use case: stylized-concept. Single individual butter-series cartoon collectible game figure, full body on a small oval bronze display base labelled exactly MOB. Bold clean black outlines, rich cel shading, softly highlighted materials, chibi black-faced butter creature with cat-ear-shaped wearable hood, round spectacles, creamy golden melting butter motif. True transparent background. Keep all limbs, ears, costume, props and pedestal fully visible with 6% clear margins. Exactly two arms and two legs with readable gloved hand grips. No mouth or mouth markings, no line eyes: all eyes must have visible iris/pupil area and circular white catchlights. Absolutely NO diamonds, diamond decorations, hearts, crowns or invader motifs. Maintain appealing original series identity. Make wardrobe, silhouette, stance and eye expression distinctly different between characters.
